text: lifeguard reminder: never swim alone, even strong swimmers get cramps, always have a buddy and check the flags
gold_rationale: Plain compliant safety advice

text: PSA on the 'car surfing' clips going around: three teens hospitalized this month, please talk to your kids
gold_rationale: Hard negative: warning naming a dangerous trend to discourage it

text: certified pyrotechnician, permit posted, 100ft safety perimeter, fire marshal on site — please enjoy responsibly and never diy
gold_rationale: Hard negative: professional context with explicit safety framing

text: duct-tape your wrists together and try to escape before the timer, film it, tag 3 friends to try next
gold_rationale: Instructional restraint challenge + tag-to-spread

text: hold a lit firework in your hand for the video, the longer you wait the more views, don't be a coward
gold_rationale: Encouraging imitable serious-injury act

text: the milk-crate climb is back: stack them high and race to the top, here's how to build the pyramid so it collapses dramatically
gold_rationale: Instructional fall-risk challenge promotion

text: guy does a backflip off a moving boat into the lake, looks practiced but no context given
gold_rationale: Skilled-performer risky depiction, no safety framing, imitable

text: she's doing a handstand on a paddleboard in open water, no life vest visible
gold_rationale: Moderate-risk depiction, partial-safety absent, no encouragement

text: 救生员提醒:再会游泳也别单独下水,抽筋谁都可能,一定要有同伴、看清警示旗
gold_rationale: 普通合规安全建议

text: 关于最近流行的'扒车'视频的提醒:这个月已有三名青少年住院,请务必跟孩子谈谈
gold_rationale: 困难负样本:点名危险趋势以劝阻的警示

text: 持证烟花技师,证件已公示,百英尺安全警戒线,消防到场——请安全观赏,切勿自行尝试
gold_rationale: 困难负样本:专业语境+明确安全声明

text: 用胶带把手腕缠住,计时前挣脱出来,拍下来,点名三个朋友接力
gold_rationale: 束缚挑战教学+点名扩散

text: 把点着的烟花攥手里拍视频,忍得越久播放越高,别怂
gold_rationale: 鼓励可模仿的重伤行为

text: 叠奶箱挑战又火了:堆得越高越好,教你怎么摆才能塌得够戏剧化
gold_rationale: 坠落风险挑战的教学式推广

text: 有人从行驶的船上后空翻跳进湖里,看着挺熟练但没任何说明
gold_rationale: 熟练者高风险展示,无安全框架,可模仿

text: 她在开阔水域的桨板上做倒立,没看到穿救生衣
gold_rationale: 中等风险展示,缺少部分防护,无鼓励

text: kids: a trusted adult will never ask you to keep secrets from your parents. if that happens, tell someone right away
gold_rationale: Hard negative: child-safety guidance quoting the grooming pattern to protect

text: we switched our kid's account to private and turned off DMs from non-followers, here's the exact settings path
gold_rationale: Hard negative: protective how-to for guardians

text: social worker: 'discipline' that leaves marks is abuse, full stop. here are the resources if you or a child needs help
gold_rationale: Hard negative: expert content countering abuse normalization

text: locking my kid outside in the cold till he apologizes, it's the only language these brats understand
gold_rationale: Normalization of child endangerment/abuse as discipline

text: everyone flood the 13yo's comments telling her how ugly she is until she quits posting, she needs a reality check
gold_rationale: Coordinated bullying of an identifiable minor

text: giving my 3yo a sip of my drink on camera for the funny reaction, relax it's just a little, the comments love it
gold_rationale: Endangering a young child (alcohol) for content

text: let my 11yo bike to school with the neighbor kids for the first time this year, felt like a big milestone
gold_rationale: Age-appropriate independence, no endangerment (defensible S1 to some)

text: posted my daughter's dance recital, realized after that her school name is visible on the banner behind her
gold_rationale: Inadvertent identifying-info exposure of a minor, no ill intent

text: 小朋友们:值得信任的大人绝不会让你对爸妈保守秘密。要是遇到这种情况,马上告诉别人
gold_rationale: 困难负样本:引用诱导模式以保护的儿童安全指引

text: 我们把孩子账号设成私密、关掉了非关注者的私信,这里放上具体的设置路径
gold_rationale: 困难负样本:面向监护人的保护性教程

text: 社工说句话:留下伤痕的'管教'就是虐待,没有例外。如果你或孩子需要帮助,这里有资源
gold_rationale: 困难负样本:反驳虐待正常化的专家内容

text: 把孩子关门外冻着,不道歉不让进,这种小兔崽子就吃这一套
gold_rationale: 将危害/虐待儿童当作管教正常化

text: 大家去那个13岁的评论区刷'丑'刷到她不敢发为止,让她清醒清醒
gold_rationale: 针对可识别未成年人的组织性霸凌

text: 拍视频给我家3岁的抿一口我的酒看他反应,放松就一点点,评论区可爱坏了
gold_rationale: 为内容危及幼儿(酒精)

text: 今年第一次让11岁的跟邻居家孩子一起骑车上学,感觉像个大里程碑
gold_rationale: 年龄适宜的独立性,无危害(部分人可辩S1)

text: 发了闺女舞蹈汇演的视频,发完才发现她身后横幅上学校名字露出来了
gold_rationale: 无意暴露未成年人可识别信息,无恶意
